I developed adult-onset allergy to a common preservative (propylene glycol/propanediol) in skincare/makeup so it's been a rough few months trying to find products that work. I wanted a daily moisturizer with niacinamide, since from experience it really makes my skin glowy, and also ceramides, which I heard helps with pore size. I also prefer oil-free since a lot of the oils used in moisturizers dry my skin out (oils don't actually hydrate, but I feel like they pull out all of the natural oils in my skin). I wear this during the day; I use prescription retinoid at night and use a different basic/cheaper moisturizer at night because I like to be generous with it and really pile it on, and this moisturizer is a bit too small in size for that. It does not pill even under two layers of sunscreen and works well under makeup. Might need a heavier one for the winter time but for spring/summer I will definitely repurchase this one!
